name: Bradco Heating and Cooling
description: A heating and cooling company serving Cochranton and the surrounding rural area.

hero.headline: Bradco Heating and Cooling
hero.sub: Furnace and AC installation, repair, and maintenance for homes around Cochranton.

items: Furnace and heating system installation and repair
Air conditioning installation, service, and tune-ups
Seasonal maintenance plans to catch problems before they fail
Serving Cochranton and the surrounding rural area
Repair and installation on both furnaces and AC systems
Maintenance plans built to catch failures before peak season
Straightforward pricing quoted before any work begins

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Bradco Heating and Cooling built its business on rural service calls where the nearest competitor is a long drive away.
The focus stays on keeping systems running through the worst weeks of summer and winter, not just fixing them after they fail.

items: A service call starts with a diagnosis and a quote before repairs begin.
Maintenance visits are scheduled ahead of peak heating and cooling season.
New installations come with a walkthrough of how to keep the system running.

feature.heading: Maintenance before the system fails
feature.text: A seasonal tune-up costs far less than an emergency furnace or AC failure in the middle of the season.

spotlight.heading: Built for rural service calls
spotlight.text: Serving a wide rural area around Cochranton means being ready to travel for both routine and emergency work.
